title: Implement and compile the selected iOS 16.5 Wi-Fi station frontend
acceptance: Verify Apple80211 request/event layouts and wifid/configd/launchd expectations against explicitly supplied iPhone X iOS16.5 components
Compile the real IO/network frontend against selected XNU, with bounded asynchronous scan/join/cancel/timeout handling and packet ownership tests
Integrate original supplicant/control broker and selected credentials path without assuming OS27 association sizes or silently replacing the first OS
Record unsupported authentication/security/privacy profiles and leave physical Settings/network qualification to NET-003
steps: Inspect selected local OS frontend ABI
Implement bounded native station/control events and signed supplicant packaging
Compile and test ownership/error paths; preserve native acceptance gates
